flag_proof.note: Native, final, BlueprintCallable. FUNC_HasOutParms (0x80000) is set but reflection lists zero params — a generator discrepancy to document; the broadcast itself passes the actor as the (implicit) first delegate parameter.

resolved_contracts: 0x142737ee0 is a thunk: shared native prologue (flag touch at [rdx+0x20]) then 'jmp 0x141bc3120'. No direct calls in the thunk (capture .json: called=[], thunk=false, 7 instructions).

0x141bc3120 is a multicast-delegate broadcast body (FMulticastDelegateBase::ProcessMulticastDelegate shape): it obtains the invocation list from a getter, increments a re-entrancy counter at list+0x14, iterates the bound entries (each 0x10 bytes, count at list+0x8), calls ProcessDelegate at bound-object vtable+0x50 with the actor as the argument, decrements the counter, and calls FMulticastDelegateBase_CompactInvocationList(list,false) when any entry was invalid/empty.
The broadcast passes the actor (param_1 / This) as the delegate argument: cVar3 = (**(code **)(*plVar1 + 0x50))(plVar1, param_1).

The delegate getter region (0x14205cc60-0x14205cc8f) is a dispatcher: 'lea rax,[rsi+0x340]; lea rcx,[rsi+0x2b0]; cmove rax,rcx; ... lea rbp,[rsi+0x340]' — it selects between base+0x340 and base+0x2b0 based on a preceding ZF condition, where the base is in rsi.
unresolved_contracts: Which ABuildingActor delegate property is broadcast. The getter computes base+0x340 (or base+0x2b0), but (a) the base register (rsi) is not visibly loaded with the actor in 0x141bc3120 under the Windows x64 ABI (rsi is a scratch register; the actor arrives in rcx), and (b) the runtime image data section is encrypted (e.g. the CDO global at 0x1481768b8 reads as 0x794d0e3046e0, not a pointer), so offsets 0x340/0x2b0 cannot be mapped to a named property by memory read.

None of ABuildingActor's named multicast delegates cleanly matches a single-actor-parameter signature: FBuildingDamagedSignature (8 params), FBuildingActorOnInteract (ABuildingActor*, AFortPawn*), FBuildingHealthChanged (0 params), FActorHealthChanged (AActor*, float). So the broadcast target is not one of the obvious named delegates without the offset->property mapping.

The exact getter entry/ABI: the bytes at 0x14205cc80 begin mid-dispatcher ('jz'), so the true function entry (with the ZF-setting test) is a few bytes earlier and was not captured as a labeled function.
